articles.headline: Ivory Coast vs. Norway - Kick-off time, team news, how to watch as Diomande faces Haaland
articles.description: Ivory Coast will take on Norway in a FIFA World Cup round of 32 clash in Arlington, Texas on Tuesday as one of world football's rising stars, Yan Diomande, faces a team featuring the likes of Erling Haaland and Martin Ødegaard.

articles.headline: World Cup 2026: Aubrey Modiba urges Hugo Broos to reconsider Bafana exit - 'he has unfinished AFCON business'
articles.description: South Africa full-back Aubrey Modiba urged manager Hugo Broos to remain in charge of Bafana Bafana beyond the World Cup.

articles.headline: Bafana's once jubilant dressing room fell quiet after Canada World Cup loss - Teboho Mokoena
articles.description: Bafana Bafana's dressing room, which is famous for being full of song, was stunned silent by Stephen Eustáquio's stoppage time winner that saw Canada beat South Africa 1-0 in the World Cup round of 32 on Sunday in Los Angeles.

articles.headline: World Cup 2026: Williams bemoans Bafana's inability to be 'clinical, 'punish' opponents
articles.description: South Africa captain Ronwen Williams believes Bafana Bafana's lack of ruthlessness in front of goal ultimately cost them a place.

articles.headline: Inside how a U.S. academy helped mold World Cup phenom Yan Diomande
articles.description: Teenager Yan Diomande is a top target for Europe's biggest clubs this summer. Before he was a star, though, he was a promising winger in Florida called "Dio."
